results.title: Podcast Ads: The Complete Guide to Monetizing Your Show [2026] | Castos
results.snippet: Four main paths: join an ad network (Midroll, Acast) if you have 10k+ downloads, use ad marketplaces (Podcorn, AdvertiseCast) at any size, do direct outreach to brands in your niche, or enable hosting platform ads like Castos Ads (one click, no minimums). CPM stands for “Cost Per Mille” (mille = thousand in Latin). It’s the cost advertisers pay per 1,000 downloads/listens. If an advertiser pays $25 CPM and your episode gets 4,000 downloads: (4,000 ÷ 1,000) × $25 = $100 in revenue. CPM rates vary based on ad placement, niche, audience quality, and demand. Dynamic ad insertion uses technology to add ads to your podcast episodes at the moment someone downloads or streams them, rather than baking ads permanently into your audio file.
